turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there! How's it going today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is it too late to learn a language at fifty?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Not at all. Adults often learn grammar and vocabulary faster than kids, they just take longer with the accent.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My accent is going to be awful.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Maybe a little, but people care much more about whether they understand you. A clear accent beats a perfect one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fair. I was thinking Portuguese, or

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: maybe Greek, since we go there every summer.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Greek would be lovely if you visit every year, you'd get real practice each trip. The alphabet takes a week or two to learn, then it's fine.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, Greek it is. Where do I start?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Learn the alphabet first, then basic greetings and food words. Locals really appreciate even a little effort.
